title: Giving agents the answer and the notes.
summary: About 20% less time per service request.

spec.problem: About 500 customer service officers searched knowledge bases and wrote post-call notes by hand during and after every call.
spec.changed: A co-pilot transcribes the call live, searches the knowledge base for suggested answers, writes the summary and pre-fills the service request.
spec.systems: DBS knowledge base and service-request system; governed under the bank's AI protocol.
spec.measured: Transcription accuracy, time per service request, officer sentiment, query volume.
spec.result: **About 20% less time per service request** across 500 staff handling 250,000+ queries a month. "Up to" wording; no published baseline. Company-reported, 2024.[^29]

evidence: Reported by the company or the press, as published. Not an xGold engagement and not an outcome a new client should expect.
